Mental Health Care Plan Details
Principal Problem:
- Patient Goal(s): Improve mood and energy; restore appetite; regain baseline functioning at work
- Clinical Goal(s): Rule out/identify medical contributors (thyroid function, anemia, organ function); obtain baseline labs; monitor symptoms; determine need for further mental health intervention
- Actions (Patient): Schedule and complete general blood tests; discuss thyroid management with GP; monitor symptoms; seek help earlier if worsening
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Order comprehensive blood tests (including anemia screen, kidney/liver function, vitamins); assess thyroid status; plan follow-up after results; determine need for physical exam if indicated; provide clear contact instructions for results and urgent concerns

Secondary Problem (if applicable):
- Patient Goal(s): Reduce anxiety/panic-like symptoms and improve coping in triggering situations
- Clinical Goal(s): Medical evaluation of palpitations/breathlessness; determine if anxiety-focused treatment is indicated
- Actions (Patient): Report symptom patterns; utilize advised coping strategies (to be provided if indicated)
- Actions (Clinician/GP): Monitor symptoms; consider referral to mental health services if persistent anxiety or mood symptoms despite medical workup

Patient Education, Emergency Care & Relapse Prevention
- Education Given: Yes. Topics Covered: Need for general blood tests; explanation of potential medical contributors to mood and energy symptoms; instructions to contact support for arranging tests; when to seek urgent care (chest pain, worsening symptoms)
